svg.title: USDEW against USDE at each close, with the estimated $10 call value and the exercise value, June 29 to October 9, 2026
svg.desc: 71 dots, one per session. 55 sessions before September 18, with USDE between $1.43 and $8.87 and USDEW between $0.36 and $2.20. 16 sessions from September 18, with USDE between $10.19 and $17.25, all but the first below the call line. From September 21 to October 7 each sat below its own session's call value, by as much as 18.2% on September 22, and on October 8 and 9 within 0.5% of it. On October 9 USDEW closed at $3.64 against a call value of $3.66. The call line rises from $2.55 at $10 to $6.50 at $18, where it meets the exercise value line, which starts at the $11.50 exercise price.
svg.text: USDEW closed below its estimated call value from September 21 to October 7
USDEW's close against USDE's close at each session, June 29 to October 9, 2026. The call line uses October 9's months to expiry.
Closes, S&P Global Market Intelligence via StockAnalysis. Make-whole table, StablecoinX warrant agreement.
